messages.text: The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Removed the tones that played when finding a pair and completing the board. Matching, visual feedback, and game state remain unchanged.

Type checking, the production build, and all 138 unit and static tests passed. The browser silence test passed through a completed board and restart. Of 77 browser tests, 76 passed; one persistence test timed out after 30 seconds, including on an isolated rerun.

The repository-wide formatting check also reported three unrelated files; the changed file passes formatting.
